# Clarification policy — planned, not implemented

Inspect all supplied conversation and repository/project context first. Record explicit facts separately from assumptions and unknowns. Ask only questions whose answers could change architecture, security, cost, user experience, acceptance, or release safety. Prefer one grouped question round and give a safe default when useful. Do not invent integrations, IDs, schemas, operations, credentials, or URLs. An unresolved consequential unknown is a blocker unless the user explicitly accepts a documented assumption.
